title: Label: Brunello di Montalcino
scenario: **Tenuta Collina** · **BRUNELLO DI MONTALCINO** · Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita · **Riserva** · **2016** · 14% vol · 750 ml · Bottled at the estate by Tenuta Collina, Montalcino

questions.stem: What is the designation of this wine?
questions.explanation: Brunello di Montalcino DOCG. Tenuta Collina is the producer; Riserva is an ageing term.

questions.stem: Which grape is this wine made from?
questions.explanation: Sangiovese — Tuscany's grape, behind Brunello and Chianti Classico.

questions.stem: In which Italian region is it made?
What does **Riserva** tell you about this wine?
choices: it comes from the historic core zone
it has more alcohol than the minimum
it aged in barrel for longer than usual
it is made from a single vineyard
questions.explanation: Riserva = longer maturation in cask or barrel. More alcohol is Superiore; the historic zone is Classico.

questions.stem: What does **DOCG** on this label guarantee?
choices: a table wine made to no particular specification
a quality wine made outside the DOC rules
Italy's largest designation, usually medium quality
Italy's highest designation, with guaranteed quality
questions.explanation: DOCG: strict production control plus a guarantee of quality. DOC is the largest class; IGT is outside DOC rules; VdT follows no specification.
